attribution: Per network below; the data belong to their publishers.
how_to_read: each station states its own unit, what the number is and which direction is wetter (groundwater depth below ground is the other way round); median is the forecast; q10..q90 is an 80% band; pct is the percentile of the median among the same time of year in the station's own history (low = low for the season); model_served false means the stronger simple baseline is what the map shows.

networks.source: British Columbia Provincial Groundwater Observation Well Network
